summary: Shipped Mach-O binary opens WebSocket-driven PTY backdoor and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The package ships a prebuilt macOS/amd64 binary (bin/sxt) that links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) and a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) with a hardcoded relay endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top. The combination provides a remote party at that relay with an interactive PTY shell on the installer's host. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and contains api-key/Authorization handling strings alongside the relay host — targeting installer-owned Claude credentials for exfiltration through the WebSocket channel. Additional strings indicate host geolocation via http://ip-api.com/json/ and a self-install/update path at https://relay.sextant.top/install with fragments referencing sudo/curl and archive fetch, giving the author's relay a remote-code delivery channel with elevated privileges. package.json declares its license via https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, whose account and repository names are consistent with the observed Claude-credential harvesting and remote-control capability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
